name: GL_SEGMENT_HIER_INTERFACE
description: This interface table is used to import segment hierarchies into Fusion.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Segment value status code. Valid value: NEW. Automatically updated by import job as needed, using values from lookup type GL_SEG_VALUE_ERROR_CODES.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_CODE
columns.description: Value set code.  Use the Manage Chart of Accounts Value Sets task to find valid values.  Foreign key to fnd_vs_value_sets table.

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.description: Tree name. Use the Manage Account Hierarchies task to find valid values.  Foreign key to FND_TREE.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_NAME
columns.description: Tree version name. Use the Manage Account Hierarchies task to find valid values.  Foreign key to FND_TREE_VERSION.

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: Segment value in the hierarchy. Validation: must be an existing value for the value set.

columns.name: PARENT_VALUE
columns.description: Parent value in the hierarchy. Validation: must be an existing parent value for the value set.

columns.name: DEPTH
columns.description: Number of ancestors a value has in the hierarchy. Must be a positive integer.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is increased every time the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date from when tree version is active. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date until tree version is valid. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created the row.

columns.name: SORT_ORDER
columns.description: Custom sort order of hierarchy node.

columns.name: LABEL_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Short label for tree version node.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: External data source from where the record originates.
